scripts.create-opsiforce-db: kubectl run -n local psql-client --restart=Never -i --tty --rm --env PGPASSWORD=dbpass1 --image=postgres:16 -- psql -h local-pg-postgresql -d postgres -U admin -c "CREATE DATABASE opsiforce;" || :
scripts.build-agent-image: sh -c 'TAG=opsiforce-agent:$(node -p "require(\"../agent-config/agent-image-version.json\").version") && minikube image ls | grep -q "$TAG" && echo "Image $TAG already exists, skipping build" || minikube image build -t $TAG -f docker/Dockerfile.agent --build-opt=build-arg=OPENCODE_CONFIG=agent-config/opencode.local.json ..'
scripts.opsiforce-install-infra: helm upgrade --install --wait --namespace local opsiforce-infra ../helm/opsiforce --set fullnameOverride=opsiforce --set storage.type=hostPath --set storage.hostPath=/workspace-data --set valkey.enabled=false --set agent.affinity=null
scripts.create-bifrost-db: kubectl run -n local psql-client-bf --restart=Never -i --tty --rm --env PGPASSWORD=dbpass1 --image=postgres:16 -- psql -h local-pg-postgresql -d postgres -U admin -c "CREATE DATABASE bifrost;" || :
scripts.minikube-dev: env-cmd -f ./local-envs.sh --use-shell 'yarn run setup-minikube-storage && yarn run build-agent-image && yarn run opsiforce-install-infra && yarn run create-opsiforce-db && yarn run create-bifrost-db && yarn run db:migrate && yarn run install-bifrost && concurrently -k -n db,mailgun,tilt "yarn run db:studio" "yarn run mailgun:mock" "yarn run tilt:up"'
